label: Death of Timur
why: Timur dies at Otrar on his way to invade Ming China, with Ankara, the sack of Delhi and the Ottoman Interregnum behind him.

realms.name: Kingdom of England
realms.note: Holds Calais, Gascony and the Lordship of Ireland; fighting Glyndŵr's revolt in Wales.

realms.name: Principality of Wales (Owain Glyndŵr)
realms.note: Rebel principality at its height; Tripartite Indenture of 28 Feb 1405 follows ten days later.

realms.name: Kingdom of Scotland
realms.ruler: Robert III (Robert, Duke of Albany, governs)

realms.name: Kingdom of France
realms.ruler: Charles VI (intermittently mad; Orléans and Burgundy contend for the council)

realms.name: Valois Burgundy
realms.note: Duke since April 1404; his mother Margaret of Dampierre holds Flanders and Artois until her death on 21 Mar 1405.

realms.name: County of Provence
realms.ruler: Louis II of Anjou (titular King of Naples)

realms.name: Holland, Zeeland and Hainaut
realms.note: William succeeded his father Albert on 13 Dec 1404.

realms.name: Duchy of Brabant
realms.ruler: Joanna (Anthony of Burgundy governs as ruwaard)

realms.name: Duchy of Milan
realms.note: Breaking up after Gian Galeazzo's death in 1402; condottieri hold many cities.

realms.name: Republic of Venice
realms.note: At war with Carrara Padua; took Vicenza 1404, takes Verona and Padua later in 1405.

realms.name: Lordship of Padua (Carrara)
realms.note: Also holds Verona; conquered by Venice in 1405.

realms.name: Republic of Genoa
realms.ruler: Governor Jean II Le Maingre (Boucicaut) for Charles VI
realms.note: Under French lordship since 1396; holds Caffa, Chios (Maona), Famagusta.

realms.name: Lordship of Pisa
realms.note: Under Boucicaut's French protection from 1404; sold to Florence in Aug 1405.

realms.name: Republic of Siena
realms.note: Free of Visconti rule since 1404.

realms.name: Avignon Papacy
realms.note: Benedict XIII had escaped the siege of the palace in 1403; obedience of France (restored 1403), Castile, Aragon, Scotland, Navarre.

realms.name: Kingdom of Naples
realms.note: Also crowned King of Hungary at Zadar in 1403 and holds parts of Dalmatia.

realms.name: Kingdom of Sicily
realms.note: Son of Martin I of Aragon; separate crown until 1409.

realms.name: Electoral Palatinate
realms.ruler: Rupert III (Rupert, King of the Romans)
realms.note: Rupert was elected King of the Romans in 1400 after Wenceslaus was deposed.

realms.name: Kingdom of Bohemia
realms.note: Still King of Bohemia though deposed as King of the Romans in 1400.

realms.name: Duchy of Austria
realms.ruler: Albert V (a minor; Duke William and Leopold IV as guardians)

realms.name: Margraviate of Meissen (Wettin)
realms.ruler: William I the One-eyed (Dresden branch; his nephews hold Thuringia)
realms.note: Wettin lands; they gain the Saxon electorate in 1423, hence the map id.

realms.name: Electorate of Saxe-Wittenberg
realms.note: Ascanian electors of Saxony.

realms.name: City of Cologne
realms.note: Self-governing since 1288; formally a free imperial city in 1475.

realms.name: Free City of Lübeck
realms.note: Head of the Hanse.

realms.name: Old Swiss Confederacy
realms.ruler: Confederate cantons (Bern, Zürich, Lucerne and others)

realms.name: Kingdom of Denmark
realms.note: Kalmar Union with Norway and Sweden since 1397.

realms.name: Kingdom of Sweden
realms.note: In the Kalmar Union.

realms.name: Kingdom of Norway
realms.note: In the Kalmar Union.

realms.name: Teutonic Order in Prussia
realms.note: Holds Gotland (since 1398), Samogitia (Raciąż 1404) and the Neumark (1402).

realms.name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
realms.note: Under Jagiełło's supreme title by the Union of Vilnius and Radom (1401); took Smolensk in 1404.

realms.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
realms.note: Tribute to the Horde lapsed; Edigu's raid comes in 1408.

realms.name: Novgorod Republic
realms.ruler: Archbishop Ioann II and the veche

realms.name: Golden Horde
realms.ruler: Khan Shadi Beg (Edigu rules as beglerbeg)
realms.note: Rebuilt by Edigu after Tokhtamysh's fall; Tokhtamysh still alive in Siberia.

realms.name: Despotate of Serbia
realms.note: Vassal of Sigismund since 1403/04, who gave him Belgrade; Branković lands split off under Ottoman protection.

realms.name: Kingdom of Bosnia
realms.note: Ostoja deposed in 1404.

realms.name: Principality of Moldavia
realms.note: Homage to Jagiełło 1402.

realms.name: Byzantine Empire
realms.ruler: Manuel II Palaiologos (John VII at Thessaloniki)
realms.note: Regained Thessaloniki and the Marmara coast by the Treaty of Gallipoli (1403).

realms.name: Duchy of Athens
realms.note: Took the Acropolis from Venice in 1403; Venice recognised him on 31 Mar 1405.

realms.name: Ottoman Sultanate (Süleyman Çelebi)
realms.note: Holds Rumelia and, since 1404, Bursa and western Anatolia; recognised by the Treaty of Gallipoli.

realms.name: Ottoman Anatolia (Mehmed Çelebi)
realms.note: Interregnum rival around Amasya and Tokat; reunites the Ottomans in 1413.

realms.name: Empire of Trebizond
realms.note: Submitted to Timur in 1402.

realms.name: Kingdom of Cyprus
realms.note: Famagusta held by Genoa.

realms.name: Kingdom of Georgia
realms.note: Ravaged by Timur's campaigns; made peace with him in 1403/04.

realms.name: Mamluk Sultanate
realms.note: Damascus rebuilt after Timur's sack of 1401; holds Ahmad Jalayir and Qara Yusuf as prisoners.

realms.name: Kingdom of Hormuz
realms.note: Tribute to the Timurids of Fars.

realms.name: Qara Qoyunlu
realms.ruler: Qara Yusuf (prisoner of the Mamluks in Damascus)
realms.note: Tribes around Van; Qara Yusuf returns after Timur's death and takes Tabriz in 1406/08.

realms.name: Aq Qoyunlu
realms.note: Given Diyarbakır by Timur in 1402.

realms.name: Timurid Empire
realms.ruler: Timur (dies this day at Otrar); princes hold the provinces
realms.note: Shah Rukh in Herat, Pir Muhammad b. Jahangir in Kabul and Kandahar, Umar and Abu Bakr b. Miran Shah in Azerbaijan and Iraq, Pir Muhammad and Iskandar b. Umar Shaykh in Fars, Rustam in Isfahan. Khalil Sultan seizes Samarkand in March.

realms.name: Moghulistan
realms.ruler: Shams-i Jahan Khan (Dughlat emirs hold Kashgar)

realms.name: Khizr Khan's Multan
realms.note: Timur's governor of Multan, Dipalpur and Lahore; takes Delhi in 1414 (Sayyids).

realms.name: Tughluq Delhi Sultanate
realms.ruler: Mallu Iqbal Khan (regent; Sultan Nasir-ud-din Mahmud Shah at Kannauj)
realms.note: Rump state after Timur's sack of 1398.

realms.name: Gujarat (Zafar Khan)
realms.ruler: Zafar Khan (declares himself Muzaffar Shah in 1407)
realms.note: De facto independent of Delhi.

realms.name: Vijayanagara Empire
realms.ruler: Virupaksha Raya II (succession strife after Harihara II, d. 1404)

realms.name: Gampola–Kotte (Alagakkonara)
realms.ruler: Vira Alakeshvara (the Gampola king Vira Bahu II nominal)
realms.note: Captured by Zheng He in 1411.

realms.name: Ming dynasty
realms.note: Beiping renamed Beijing in 1403; Zheng He's first voyage sails in July 1405.

realms.name: Joseon
realms.note: Court returns to Hanseong in Oct 1405.

realms.name: Ashikaga Shogunate
realms.ruler: Shogun Ashikaga Yoshimochi (Yoshimitsu rules in retirement); Emperor Go-Komatsu

realms.name: Chūzan (Ryukyu)
realms.note: One of three Okinawan kingdoms; Shō Hashi overthrows Bunei in 1406.

realms.name: Northern Yuan
realms.note: Eastern Mongols divided; khan's seat uncertain.

realms.name: Đại Ngu (Hồ dynasty)
realms.ruler: Hồ Hán Thương (Hồ Quý Ly as retired emperor)
realms.note: Ming invades in 1406.

realms.name: Malacca Sultanate
realms.note: Founded c. 1400; tributary ties to Ayutthaya, sends envoys to Ming 1405.

realms.name: Majapahit
realms.note: Paregreg civil war (1404–06) with Bhre Wirabhumi of the eastern court.

realms.name: Maynila
realms.note: Small Tagalog polity on the Pasig; little is known before the 1500s.

realms.name: Sayfawa (Bornu)
realms.note: Driven out of Kanem by the Bulala in the 1380s.

realms.name: Bulala
realms.note: Holds Kanem and Njimi.

realms.name: Kingdom of Kongo
realms.ruler: Lukeni lua Nimi or his successor (traditional)
realms.note: Foundation date (c. 1390) is traditional.

realms.name: Ethiopian Empire
realms.note: Defeated Ifat; Sa'ad ad-Din II killed at Zeila (1403 or 1410/15, disputed).

realms.name: Tepanec altepetl of Azcapotzalco
realms.note: Hegemon of the Valley of Mexico.

realms.name: Principality of Achaea
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.name: Hokuzan
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.name: Sultanate of Ifat
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.name: Jalayirid Sultanate
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised. Ahmad back in Baghdad after Timur left the west.

realms.name: Nanzan
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.name: Judicate of Arborea
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.name: Archbishopric of Riga
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

realms.name: Beylik of Saruhan
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised. Restored by Timur after Ankara (1402); Ottoman again 1410.

realms.name: Tondo
realms.note: Still standing; carried forward when realm ids were harmonised.

bruges.note: Flanders, held by Margaret of Dampierre (widow of Philip the Bold) until 21 Mar 1405, within the Valois Burgundian union.

algiers.note: Local notables under loose Zayyanid (sometimes Hafsid) suzerainty.

pisa.note: Gabriele Maria Visconti; sold to Florence Aug 1405, taken Oct 1406.

cologne.note: Self-governing city; the archbishop resides at Bonn.

bern.note: City-state of Bern, member of the Confederacy.

riga.note: City of Riga with the Archbishop of Riga as lord, disputed with the Livonian Order.

belgrade.note: Granted to Stefan Lazarević by Sigismund c. 1403/04.

bursa.note: Süleyman took Bursa from Mehmed in his Anatolian campaign, usually dated 1404.

tabriz.note: Timurid Azerbaijan under Miran Shah's sons.

baghdad.note: Retaken from Ahmad Jalayir c. 1403/04; Jalayirids return later in 1405.

urgench.note: Timurid Khwarazm; Edigu's Horde occupies it soon after Timur's death.

kashgar.note: Dughlat emirs of Moghulistan; Timurid raids in 1399–1400.

lahore.note: Khizr Khan's Timurid governorship; Khokhar chiefs contest it.

colombo.note: Western coast under Alagakkonara of Kotte; Gampola kings nominal.

hakata.note: Shogunal Kyushu tandai (Shibukawa); Ōuchi and Shōni influence.

timbuktu.note: Malian until the Tuareg take it c. 1433.

gao.note: Gao under the Sonni, largely free of Mali by c. 1400.

kanem.note: Bulala hold Kanem after expelling the Sayfawa.

zeila.note: Depends on the date of Sa'ad ad-Din II's death (1403 or 1410/15); otherwise Ifat.

tzintzuntzan.note: Early Purépecha state; its centre was then Pátzcuaro.

mayapan.note: Mayapan's fall is dated between c. 1441 and 1461.

havana.note: Taíno and Guanahatabey chiefdoms, no state.

bogota.note: Zipazgo chronology before c. 1450 is legendary.

quebec.note: St. Lawrence Iroquoian village of Stadacona, no state.

singapore.note: Temasek abandoned after its sack c. 1398; Orang Laut, no state.

open_questions: Interregnum Ottomans are split between 'ottomans' (Süleyman, Edirne) and 'ottoman_mehmed' (Amasya); the date of Süleyman's crossing to take Bursa (1403 or 1404) is debated.
Kalmar Union: Denmark, Sweden and Norway are listed as separate realms under one king with no overlord; a run may model the union as one realm.
Lithuania is listed without an overlord though Vytautas ruled under Jagiełło's supreme title (1401).
Bruges: Flanders was Margaret of Dampierre's own county until 21 Mar 1405; counted for burgundy.

Dresden: the Wettin Margraviate of Meissen is given the map id 'saxony' (its 1444 successor); the Ascanian electorate is 'saxe_wittenberg'. The catalogue id 'meissen' is the prince-bishopric, so it is not used.
Zeila: Sa'ad ad-Din II's death at Zeila is dated 1403 by some and 1410 or 1415 by others; holder ethiopia vs. ifat.
Baghdad: Timurid (Abu Bakr b. Miran Shah) or already back with Ahmad Jalayir; most accounts put the Jalayirid return after Timur's death.
Vijayanagara's ruler between Harihara II's death (Aug 1404) and Deva Raya I (Nov 1406) is disputed (Virupaksha Raya II, Bukka Raya II).
Jalayirids are listed as ended though they return to Baghdad later in 1405; Ahmad was then a Mamluk prisoner and they held no territory on this date.
Joseon (1392) and the Hồ dynasty (1400) are treated as dynasty changes inside 'korea' and 'dai_viet', not new realms.
African and American rulers (Mali, Songhai, Benin, Kongo, Kilwa, Chimor, Muisca, Inca) rest on traditional or reconstructed chronologies.
Algiers' status c. 1405 (Zayyanid, Hafsid or autonomous) is unclear.

Id harmonisation: realms still standing in 1405 but missing from this list were added (Achaea, Hokuzan, Ifat, Jalayirids, Nanzan, Arborea, Riga, Saruhan, Tondo); Flanders, Brankovic lands, Thopia Albania and Visconti Pavia are counted as ended (absorbed by Burgundy, the Ottomans, Venice and Milan).
Carrara Padua uses padua, Menteşe mentese and Nizhny Novgorod suzdal_nizhny. Smolensk was dropped from 'ended' because the 1378 checkpoint does not list it.
since_previous.first_listed names realms that existed in 1378 but are listed for the first time here; they are not 'formed'.
